title: the support bundle's scrub: an encoded pseudonym left in part

findings.claim: an encoded neighbour (%2F, %22) joined its hex digit to a pseudonym on the raw line; the phone pattern cut it and the decoded view, run after, saw fragments: 8 to 13 hex digits of a pseudonym left a support bundle (the invariant test failed about once in 60 runs); fixed: the decoded view first

the keep-the-encoded-line shortcut lined the two lines up by one regex of lazy groups, which backtracked without end: 24 masks on a 335-character line took 9.7 s, each 4 more 16 times as long (review of #1354, H1); fixed: a linear mask-for-mask comparison

the shortcut kept a raw line whose two raw rules (phone and a chart pattern) cut a pseudonym into pieces under 8 characters, so up to 7 digits of it left (review of #1354, M1); fixed: the raw line is kept only when its masks are the decoded view's one for one
the shortcut exists to keep two tests that pin the encoded form of a scrubbed line (review of #1354, L1); stated on the page for the integrator's ruling
seeded tests no longer explore new pseudonyms (review of #1354, L2); 1,800 more fixed draws with chart patterns of 5 to 10 digits
the card had no page and no findings.json (review of #1354, L3); added

the decoded view was scrubbed on its own: an encoded separator inside a secret's value (a space, a quote, a line break) cut the value and its rest left a bundle (re-read of #1354, H2; this line's own, not master's); fixed: the secret rule runs on the raw line first

a secret after an unquoted key ({password: "S"}, YAML, a JS object), after a key behind '/', or under a mixed-case name left a support bundle, on master too (the bench's probe); fixed: the colon rule takes a quoted value and a key after '/', and a secret's name is read whole; the invariant: never more secret lines than master's scrub on the same corpus
the scrub's timing test added 20 ms of slack to a ratio of small times, so it could pass a quadratic scrub or fail on a slow runner; fixed: bounds from one helper, 1,000 against 4,000 masks, no slack
three mutants of the mask comparison died only on its direct test; fixed: two die through the public path, the third (any case) is equivalent

test_a_member_put_in_past_add_is_scrubbed_before_it_is_written fails about 1 run in 100: Bundle.add writes the old log scrubber's pass on the raw text, whose phone pattern takes a run of 10 or more digits inside a pseudonym before the pseudonym rule, so 21 hex digits of it leave; not H2; on H-76 (b3239845) the pass is counted, not written, and 200 seeds pass

after round 3, 108 of the never-more corpus's 4,000 lines still left their secret value (an unquoted key, an encoded space, then the quoted value, as in GET /p/%2F{k:%20"v"}; 54 + 54 lines): the raw colon rule masked the encoded space alone; fixed: a value that decodes to nothing is no value, and the colon rule takes an encoded space before a quoted value; the corpus now leaves no line
